title: daily intelligence brief for technical founders
headline: Know what changes your next move
primary_keyword: daily intelligence brief for technical founders
subhead: Forward the sources you trust, select public repos, and get one concise evidence-linked morning edition: what changed, why it matters, and what to inspect next.
problem: Decision-relevant technical and market signals are fragmented across inboxes, feeds, research, data, and GitHub. Operators spend time reconciling them and can still miss a change that affects a build, vendor, or positioning decision.
offer: A founding pilot that turns forwarded newsletters, selected public sources, tracked data, and up to five selected public GitHub repos into one ranked morning email with evidence and a next move.
